title: Pyrique Redwing
summary: Find Pyrique's true shadow in repeated forty-second damage windows.
overview: Find Pyrique's true shadow in repeated forty-second damage windows.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Identify the real shadow quickly, focus enough damage for the current window, and reassess after every shuffle.

phases.label: Opening
phases.description: Engage Pyrique and prepare target identification.

phases.label: Shadows
phases.description: Win six forty-second checks by reducing the real shadow to 90% or lower.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 80% health, Pyrique disappears and creates six shadows, only one of which is real.
Every forty seconds the shadows are replaced and their positions reshuffled.
Bring the real shadow to 90% health or lower before each check. Six successful checks reveal the final killable Pyrique.
Directly killing the real shadow also creates the final body in this implementation.
An idle final body has a five-minute cleanup check.

notes: Approval E400. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The source explicitly treats killing the real shadow as an uncertain historical behavior; that alternate transition needs live validation.
